mechanism: On each bar, close lot Lc(X)=StartLotsToOnePoint·X^D where X=prior fully formed bar move in points toward profit and D=ln(End/Start)/ln(PointsForEndLots). Larger/faster prior impulse → larger partial close (expects stronger rollback). Works on bars or ticks.
data_needed: Open[0]-Open[1] in points; StartLotsToOnePoint, PointsForEndLots, EndLotsToOnePoint; open position lots.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDCHF M5 2000–2021 demo; any symbol/TF; ticks optional

quote: The more powerful the impulse and the less its duration, the greater the probability of a rollback in the near future and the greater the magnitude of the expected rollback.

mechanism: Incremental µ/σ of abs(Δindicator)/_Point; after learn-rate≥0.5 classify val/µ into CatCoeff bins {0,0.33,0.76,1.32,2.04,2.98,4.21,5.80,7.87}+overflow. Empiric rule: |slope|<0.5·µ → flat/range; |slope|>1.0·µ → trend. HalfTrend horizontal cluster often ~66–69% of bars.
data_needed: Indicator line series (HalfTrend up/down buffers); _Point; NumValues; CatCoeff; learning-rate schedule over history.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: GBPUSD D1 (~7300 bars) and M15 (~556k bars); HalfTrend Amplitude=2; extensible to any indicator

quote: if fabs(slope) < 0.5*µ => the market is flat, try a range trading / if fabs(slope) > 1.0*µ => the market has a trend, try to ride the wave
